Everything you need to know about Fontaine, the aquatic Nation of Justice.

         ![Image 1: Waterfalls in the distance showing the entrance to fontaine.](https://assetsio.gnwcdn.com/Genshin-Impact-Fontaine-guide%2C-including-Fontaine-characters%2C-Archon-Quests%2C-and-World-Quests-cover.jpg?width=690&quality=85&format=jpg&dpr=3&auto=webp)

Image credit: HoYoverse

**Fontaine** is the fifth nation the Traveler and Paimon travel to during the main story of **Genshin Impact**, but anybody who has completed Mondstadt's Archon Quests can head to the Nation of Justice whenever they like.

Added during [version 4.0](https://www.eurogamer.net/genshin-impact-4-0-release-date-time-banner-schedule-events-9326), Fontaine has all of the usual bells and whistles like new Archon Quests, [Reputation system](https://www.eurogamer.net/genshin-impact-how-to-unlock-fontaine-reputation-level-rewards-quests-9326), Commissions, World Quests, domains, and bosses - but Fontaine's unique addition is its new [underwater exploration](https://www.eurogamer.net/genshin-impact-swimming-diving-spots-underwater-mechanics-abilities-9326) mechanic.

Our **Fontaine guide** breaks down everything you need to know about the Hydro nation's surface and waters in [Genshin Impact](https://www.eurogamer.net/games/genshin-impact), from a list of **all Fontaine characters** and **Fontaine Archon Quests**, to links to all of our guides related to Fontaine. So check back regularly for new additions!

On this page:

*   [Everything new added to Fontaine](https://www.eurogamer.net/genshin-impact-fontaine-guide-characters-archon-quests-world-9326#section-1)
*   [Fontaine characters list](https://www.eurogamer.net/genshin-impact-fontaine-guide-characters-archon-quests-world-9326#section-2)
*   [Fontaine Archon Quest list](https://www.eurogamer.net/genshin-impact-fontaine-guide-characters-archon-quests-world-9326#section-3)
*   [Fontaine World Quest list](https://www.eurogamer.net/genshin-impact-fontaine-guide-characters-archon-quests-world-9326#section-4)

For more help in Genshin Impact, check out our [next Banner](https://www.eurogamer.net/genshin-impact-next-banner-current-list-all-history-9026), redemption [codes](https://www.eurogamer.net/genshin-impact-codes-livestream-active-working-how-to-redeem-9026), and [beginner's guide](https://www.eurogamer.net/genshin-impact-beginners-guide-tips-tricks-9326) pages.

Everything new added to Fontaine in Genshin Impact
--------------------------------------------------

Here's a short list of everything noteworthy **added to Fontaine in Genshin Impact**:

*   [Underwater exploration](https://www.eurogamer.net/genshin-impact-swimming-diving-spots-underwater-mechanics-abilities-9326)
*   New Artifact sets
*   New battle pass weapons
*   [Craftable weapons](https://www.eurogamer.net/how-to-get-fontaine-craftable-weapons-genshin-impact-9326)
*   Archon Quests
*   World Quests
*   Multi-layered map update
*   [Encounter Points system](https://www.eurogamer.net/how-to-get-encounter-points-genshin-impact-earn-adventure-encounters-9326)
*   TCG Spectator mode
*   New TCG cards and backs
*   New party menu backgrounds and poses
*   New bosses
*   New enemies
*   Pneuma and Ousia Energy for combat and puzzles
*   Increase in Artifact inventory limit to 1,800
*   Eight new Artifact Sets for 'Mystic Offering'

The big new addition exclusive to Fontaine is underwater exploration. You can dive almost anywhere in the region to explore vast underwater areas, with combat, exploration, and puzzle mechanics unique to underwater travel. To aid with navigating the water and land, a multi-layer map feature debuted in [version 4.0](https://www.eurogamer.net/genshin-impact-4-0-release-date-time-banner-schedule-events-9326) with Fontaine.

![Image 2](https://www.eurogamer.net/Genshin-Impact-leaker-calls-out-developer's-weak-security-and-clout-chasers-while-dropping-Fontaine-details-cover.jpg)

There are also additions that we've come to expect from each new region in Genshin Impact, such as new [Reputation rewards](https://www.eurogamer.net/genshin-impact-how-to-unlock-fontaine-reputation-level-rewards-quests-9326), [fishing](https://www.eurogamer.net/genshin-impact-fishing-how-to-unlock-fish-every-rod-bait-listed-9026) spots, [Shrine of Depths](https://www.eurogamer.net/genshin-impact-fontaine-shrine-of-depths-locations-how-to-get-keys-9326), Sigil exchange at the [Fountain of Lucine](https://www.eurogamer.net/genshin-impact-how-to-unlock-fountain-of-lucine-rewards-9326), and lots of new Teleport Waypoints and Statues of Seven. Any reguar feature or system available in the other regions is available in Fontaine as well.

![Image 3: Nahinda floating underwater in front of a blue glowing fontaine shrine of the depth.](https://www.eurogamer.net/Genshin-Impact-Fontaine-Shrine-of-Depths-locations-and-how-to-get-Keys-cover.jpg)

Image credit: Eurogamer/HoYoverse

Genshin Impact Fontaine characters list
---------------------------------------

We know of 12 new playable characters from Fontaine. The list of **all Fontaine characters in Genshin Impact** so far is:

*   [Arlecchino](https://www.eurogamer.net/genshin-impact-arlecchino-materials-ascension-talent-kit-constellations-9426)
*   Charlotte (4-Star - released Version 4.2 Phase 1)
*   Chevreuse (4-Star - released Version 4.3 Phase 2)
*   Clorinde
*   Freminet (4-Star - released Version 4.0 Phase 2)
*   [Furina](https://www.eurogamer.net/genshin-impact-furina-materials-ascension-talent-kit-constellations) (5-Star - released Version 4.2 Phase 1)
*   Lynette (4-Star - released Version 4.0 Phase 1)
*   [Lyney](https://www.eurogamer.net/genshin-impact-lyney-ascension-talent-materials-best-build-team-weapon-artifact-constellations-9326) (5-Star - released Version 4.0 Phase 1)
*   [Navia](https://www.eurogamer.net/genshin-impact-navia-materials-ascension-talent-kit-constellations-9326) (5-Star - released Version 4.3 Phase 1)
*   [Neuvillette](https://www.eurogamer.net/genshin-impact-neuvillette-materials-ascension-talent-kit-constellations-9326) (5-Star - released Version 4.1 Phase 1)
*   Sigewinne
*   [Wriothesley](https://www.eurogamer.net/genshin-impact-wriothesley-materials-ascension-talent-kit-constellations) (5-Star - released Version 4.1 Phase 2)

The Hydro version of The Traveler also debuted with Fontaine, but we don't really classify them as a Fontaine character exactly - but the Hydro Traveler can jump and dive while swimming like other Fontaine natives!

![Image 4: Promotion image of Neuvillette on a white background.](https://www.eurogamer.net/Genshin-Impact-Neuvillette-1.jpg)

Starting from the top, left to right: Neuvillette, Navia, Clorinde, and Chevreuse.

[Navia](https://www.eurogamer.net/genshin-impact-navia-materials-ascension-talent-kit-constellations-9326) and Chevreuse are available to Wish for during [version 4.3](https://www.eurogamer.net/genshin-impact-4-3-release-date-time-banner-schedule-events-9326), but we'll have to wait on official details for the release order of the remaining Fontaine characters, and any more added in the future. You can check our [next Banner](https://www.eurogamer.net/genshin-impact-next-banner-current-list-all-history-9026) page to keep up to date with all the latest leaks and official information on future Fontaine characters.

* * *

_Version 6.2 has brought the new 5-Star [Durin](https://www.eurogamer.net/genshin-impact-durin-materials-ascension-talent-kit-constellations) and the new 4-Star [Jahoda](https://www.eurogamer.net/genshin-impact-jahoda-materials-ascension-talent-kit-constellations). Elsewhere, we have [tips and tricks for beginners](https://www.eurogamer.net/genshin-impact-beginners-guide-tips-tricks-9326)._

You can now build a team around a specific character card and card switching has been optimized! ### Optimizations For Version 5.6 #### Treasure Compass & Exploration Updates * Treasure Compass now tracks Warrior's Challenges in Natlan. * Treasure Compass can now track Obsidian Fragment Chests and Mora Chests when you have high Exploration Progress. * Batch Deletion of Map Pins can now be done via filtering by region and marker category. #### Character Skill and Constellation Optimizations * Character Skill and Constellation descriptions can be toggled for a simplified version. * Clickable links for certain terms in a character's Skill/Constallation description has also been added. #### Character Enhancement Related Updates * Adventurer's Handbook UI now displays the Domain categories based on type and sorted the domains by region opening time starting from the newest to oldest. * Crafting Bench will now show a prompt once all held materials are enough to meet the set Ascension requirement. * Once a character has been selected within the Crafting Bench UI, you will be redirected to the set crafting interface even if you leave to collect materials. * Character filter icon in the Crafting Bench has been moved to the top-left corner. * Real-time collection progress of Enhancement Materials will be included on the lower right item collection prompt as well as on Domain and Bosses settlement screens. #### Imaginarium Theatre QoL Updates * Players will be able to see the information of the Brilliant Blessings chosen and Blessing branches available. * New Stella rewards have been added for the Imaginarium Theatre. * You can now restart the final boss stage in Imaginarium Theatre.
